title: Separate the variables
text: Move everything with $$y$$ to one side with dy, and everything with the other variable to the other side, then integrate both sides.

title: Integrate and solve
text: Integrating $$e^{\left(-y\right)} dy=5^x$$ dx gives $$-e^{\left(-y\right)}=\frac{5^x}{\ln\left(5\right)}+C$$. At $$x=0$$, $$e^{\left(-y\right)}=\frac{1}{\ln\left(5\right)}$$, so $$C=\frac{-2}{\ln\left(5\right)}$$. Then $$e^{\left(-y\right)}=\frac{2-5^x}{\ln\left(5\right)}$$, so $$y=\ln\left(\ln\left(5\right)\right)-\ln\left(2-5^x\right)$$.
